verdict.rationale: Portkey documents a unified, OpenAI-compatible interface to 250+ models across many providers, which implies a consistent request schema. It also mentions connecting to remote MCP servers for external tools. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly covers function or tool calling, or how tool schemas are normalized across providers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of tool/function calling support, cross-provider normalization of tool call request and response schemas, streaming tool-call handling, and hands-on corroboration.
